actions.text: ASSUMING FIRST SPONSORSHIP - Mr. Gallagher asked unanimous consent that he may hereafter be considered as the first sponsor of H.R. 1420, a bill originally introduced by Representative LaMalfa, for the purpose of adding cosponsors and requesting reprintings pursuant to clause 7 of rule XII. Agreed to without objection.
Referred to the Subcommittee on Conservation, Research, and Biotechnology.
Referred to the House Committee on Agriculture.

dimensions.assessment: Affects agricultural landowners and farmers in specific regions seeking to enroll working cropland into conservation reserve enhancement programs.
dimensions.evidence: permit seasonally flooded agricultural uses on such working cropland with the adoption of at least one best management practice

dimensions.assessment: Provides administrative flexibility for agricultural land enrollment and rental payment calculations without mandating large economy-wide changes.
dimensions.evidence: calculate annual rental payments in a manner that is comparable with annual costs to maintain other seasonally-flooded wetland wildlife habitats

dimensions.assessment: May alter federal rental payments and matching fund requirements for specific conservation agreements.
dimensions.evidence: calculate annual rental payments... the Secretary may waive the matching requirement described in subsection (c)(1)

dimensions.assessment: Amends a specific section of the Food Security Act of 1985 regarding wetland wildlife habitats and working agricultural lands.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1231A of the Food Security Act of 1985 is amended

dimensions.assessment: Makes permanent statutory amendments to the Food Security Act governing long-term conservation agreements.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Food Security Act of 1985 to allow for additional agricultural lands to be enrolled

missing_information: The total acreage and federal financial outlay expected from these new agreement authorities are not quantified.
importance_detail.rationale: Modifies the Conservation Reserve Enhancement Program to allow seasonally flooded working lands habitat conservation agreements, non-eligible land enrollment in certain circumstances, and matching requirement waivers.
